hero.label: Made for Conveo
hero.headline: I want to help Conveo bring AI research to every growth team.
hero.subheadline: AI-led interviews that replace slow, expensive research panels is a genuinely disruptive idea, and I think the market is ready for it right now. I have spent the last year doing exactly what this role requires: finding the right buyers, earning their attention, and moving them through a pipeline. I want to do that for a product I actually believe is changing how companies learn from their customers.

whyCompany.title: AI-led research flips a painful, overpriced market on its head
whyCompany.body: Traditional consumer research is slow, costly, and gatekept by agencies. Conveo compresses that cycle with AI interviewers that run at scale without losing quality. That is a clear, urgent value proposition to pitch, and buyers in product, marketing, and strategy already feel the pain Conveo solves.

whyCompany.title: Early BDR hire means real ownership of how the pipeline is built
whyCompany.body: Joining at the stage where the BDR motion is still being shaped means the playbooks I help write will actually stick. That is not a role I take lightly. I want to be the person who figures out which sequences, which personas, and which messages make the market respond.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and digital marketing reps prove I can find and convert buyers
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end to end through HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped bring in 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch. At NextAfter I moved into a B2B digital environment and learned how content and targeting layer on top of direct outreach. Both experiences map directly to what Conveo needs from a BDR on day one.

quote: I have been the person who built pipeline from nothing, and I know how much easier that job gets when you genuinely believe the product deserves to win. I believe Conveo does.
